address: 2-3F, Block A, Xinhuafu Plaza, 173 Wusi Road, Gulou, Fuzhou, China Mainland
bio: Min Shi Fu is well known for its live seafood and local delicacies. There is no menu. Just pick your own ingredients from the live fish tank and ask the server to recommend the best ways to prepare them. In addition to live shrimps, crabs, bivalves and whelks, the signature oyster fritter is very popular and boasts plump oysters, aromatic scallion and crisply fried egg batter. Everything is cooked to order and showcases solid techniques....
